mechanism: Montelukast may potentiate dopaminergic effects and increase CNS stimulation when combined with levodopa, potentially exacerbating neuropsychiatric adverse effects; additionally, montelukast is metabolized by CYP3A4 and 2C9 while carbidopa-levodopa has minimal hepatic metabolism, creating moderate pharmacokinetic complexity.
action: Monitor for increased neuropsychiatric symptoms (agitation, anxiety, mood changes, insomnia) and dopaminergic side effects; dose adjustment of either agent may be necessary if adverse effects emerge.
